questions.question: As per the Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC), a very severe cyclonic storm is forecast to make landfall between which two locations in Andhra Pradesh on October 28?
questions.explanation: The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) has forecast a very severe cyclonic storm to make landfall between Bapatla and Vizag in Andhra Pradesh on October 28, with wind speeds potentially reaching up to 130 kmph.
questions.background: The IMD has issued a red alert for 13 districts in Andhra Pradesh for October 27 and 28 in anticipation of the cyclonic storm. Heavy to very heavy rain is also forecast for isolated places in Tamil Nadu.
questions.examRelevance: Cyclonic storm landfall location and date in Andhra Pradesh.

source.title: Andhra Pradesh braces for very severe cyclonic storm; landfall likely between Bapatla and Vizag on October 28

questions.question: How many launch pads is ISRO aiming to have by 2029, including the upcoming facility at Kulasekarapattinam?
questions.explanation: ISRO chief S. Somanath stated that ISRO plans to have a total of four launch pads by 2029, which includes the existing facilities and the new spaceport facility being developed at Kulasekarapattinam.
questions.background: The Kulasekarapattinam spaceport in Tamil Nadu is being developed to feature crucial infrastructure such as integration buildings, launch pads, rail-track systems, and telemetry, tracking, and command systems, primarily for launching small satellite launch vehicles (SSLVs).
questions.examRelevance: ISRO's future launch infrastructure expansion and key locations.

source.title: ISRO to have four launch pads by 2029, says Narayanan

questions.question: Amid protests and political uncertainty, which European country's restrictive abortion law is currently facing two new bills aiming to ease its limits?

questions.question: Which Indian district is experiencing a steep decline in its camel population due to industrialisation, mining, and shrinking grazing grounds?

questions.question: A recent study has identified 'feral dogs' as a major threat to vultures in which Indian desert?

questions.background: Vultures play a crucial role as scavengers in the ecosystem, and their declining populations are a serious environmental concern. Competition and disturbance from feral dog populations exacerbate the challenges faced by these birds.

source.title: Feral dogs ‘a major threat’ to vultures in Thar desert, study finds
